# Weekly Dinner Plan (Saturday–Thursday)

A note on approach: all six meals are naturally vegetarian (egg/dairy included), so you can cook one pot for everyone — simplest and cheapest with a two-burner setup. If you want meat in your own bowl, I've flagged quick add-ins.

Since you shop on **Sunday**, Saturday's dinner is built from pantry/freezer staples that keep well from the week before (canned, frozen, dry goods) — no fresh produce needed that's likely to spoil by the following weekend.

---

### Saturday — Coconut Chickpea Curry & Rice (~50 min)
*Mild, not spicy — just curry powder, no chili.*
- 1 tbsp oil, 1 onion (diced), 2 cloves garlic
- 1 tsp mild curry powder
- 1 can diced tomatoes, 1 can coconut milk, 1 can chickpeas (drained)
- 1 cup frozen spinach
- 1.5 cups rice, uncooked

**Steps:** Start rice on burner #1 (per package). On burner #2: sauté onion/garlic 5 min → add curry powder, stir 1 min → add tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas → simmer 15 min → stir in spinach last 3 min. Serve over rice.

💡 **Cook extra rice** — you'll reuse leftovers Monday and Wednesday.

---

### Sunday — Stovetop "Baked" Ziti (~45 min)
- 8 oz ziti or penne
- 1 jar marinara (or crushed tomatoes + garlic + oregano)
- 1 cup ricotta, 1.5 cups shredded mozzarella, parmesan (optional)
- Salt, pepper, dried basil/oregano

**Steps:** Boil pasta (10–12 min), drain. In the same pot, warm marinara, stir pasta back in, dollop ricotta throughout, top with mozzarella, cover on low heat 5–8 min until melted.

*Meat add-in for you: stir cooked ground beef or sausage into your own portion before topping with cheese.*

---

### Monday — Black Bean & Rice Bowls (25 min)
- Leftover rice from Saturday
- 1 can black beans (drained), 1 cup frozen corn, 1 tsp cumin
- Shredded cheddar, mild salsa, plain yogurt or sour cream, avocado (optional)

**Steps:** Reheat rice in microwave. In a pan, warm beans + corn + cumin with a splash of water, ~8 min. Assemble bowls with toppings.

---

### Tuesday — Tomato Butter Pasta with Peas (25 min)
- 8 oz pasta
- 1 can crushed tomatoes, 2 tbsp butter, 1 onion (halved)
- 1 cup frozen peas
- Parmesan

**Steps:** Boil pasta. Simultaneously simmer tomatoes + butter + onion halves 15 min (classic simple sauce), discard onion, stir in peas last 3 min, toss with pasta, top with parmesan.

---

### Wednesday — Veggie Egg Fried Rice (25 min)
- Leftover rice from Saturday
- 2–3 eggs, 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables
- 2 tbsp soy sauce, garlic, oil, sesame oil (optional)

**Steps:** Scramble eggs, set aside. Sauté veggies + garlic in same pan, add rice + soy sauce, stir eggs back in. ~10 min total.

---

### Thursday — Quick Red Lentil Soup (25 min)
- 1 cup red lentils, 1 can diced tomatoes
- 1 onion, 1 carrot (diced), garlic
- 4 cups broth or water, cumin, salt
- Bread or crackers to serve

**Steps:** Sauté onion, carrot, garlic 5 min → add lentils, tomatoes, broth → simmer 15–18 min until lentils are soft. Serve with bread.

---

## Sunday Shopping List

**Produce**
- Onions (4)
- Garlic (1 head)
- Carrot (1)
- Avocado (optional)

**Canned/Jarred**
- Diced tomatoes (2 cans)
- Crushed tomatoes (1 can)
- Coconut milk (1 can)
- Chickpeas (1 can)
- Black beans (1 can)
- Marinara sauce (1 jar)
- Mild salsa (1 small jar)

**Frozen**
- 1 bag mixed vegetables (covers peas, corn, and fried-rice veggies — buy one bag, portion it out across Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday)
- Extra bag of peas or corn if the mixed bag doesn't have enough

**Grains/Dry Goods**
- Rice (2 lb bag)
- Pasta — ziti/penne (1 box, split between Sun & Tue)
- Red lentils (1 bag)
- Bread or crackers

**Dairy/Eggs**
- Eggs (1 dozen)
- Ricotta (15 oz)
- Shredded mozzarella
- Shredded cheddar
- Parmesan
- Butter
- Plain yogurt or sour cream

**Pantry Staples** (check what you already have)
- Oil, salt, pepper
- Mild curry powder
- Cumin
- Dried oregano/basil
- Soy sauce
- Sesame oil (optional)

---

### Time-saving tip
Cook a big batch of rice Saturday — it covers Saturday, Monday, and Wednesday, cutting real cook time on two of your busiest weeknights.

Here's a Saturday–Thursday dinner plan built around your setup (2 burners, no oven, 25 min on weeknights, 1 hour on weekends). Since I wasn't sure whether you or your kiddo eat meat, I made every meal vegetarian at its core (so everyone can eat the same pot) and added an **optional quick protein add-in** for meat-eaters — just skip those if not needed.

## The Plan

### Saturday — Fried Rice (Pantry Night, ~30 min)
*Uses staples, since this is before your Sunday shop.*
- Burner 1: heat oil in a wok/large skillet, scramble 2-3 eggs, push aside.
- Same pan: sauté garlic + a bag of frozen mixed veg, add day-old (or quick-cooked) rice, soy sauce, sesame oil.
- Optional add-in: diced leftover chicken/ham/shrimp tossed in at the end.

### Sunday — Veggie Lentil Soup + Grilled Cheese (~55 min, shopping day)
- Burner 1: sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic in oil; add canned tomatoes, lentils, broth, cumin, bay leaf; simmer ~35–40 min.
- Burner 2: make grilled cheese sandwiches while soup simmers (bread + butter + cheese).
- Mild, filling, freezes well if you want extra for lunches.

### Monday — Butter Pea Parmesan Pasta (~20 min)
- Burner 1: boil pasta.
- Burner 2: melt butter, sauté garlic + frozen peas, toss with pasta, splash of pasta water + parmesan.
- Optional add-in: pan-sear sliced smoked sausage or shrimp on burner 2 before making the sauce, set aside, stir back in for meat portions.

### Tuesday — Build-Your-Own Rice Bowls (~20 min)
- Microwave rice pouches (saves both burners).
- Burner 1: warm black beans + corn + a little taco seasoning.
- Burner 2 (optional): brown ground beef or shredded rotisserie chicken with taco seasoning.
- Set out shredded cheese, salsa (mild), sour cream, lime — everyone builds their own bowl.

### Wednesday — Egg Drop Noodle Soup with Tofu (~20 min)
- One pot: simmer broth with soy sauce, ginger/garlic, sesame oil; add noodles (ramen minus seasoning packet, or vermicelli) and diced tofu.
- Swirl in beaten eggs at the end for ribbons; frozen peas/corn stirred in for veg.
- Optional add-in: swap or add cooked shrimp/thin chicken slices instead of (or alongside) tofu.

### Thursday — Creamy Tomato Pasta with Spinach (~20 min)
- Burner 1: boil pasta.
- Burner 2: warm jarred tomato sauce with a splash of cream/milk, stir in baby spinach until wilted, toss with pasta + parmesan.
- Optional add-in: browned Italian sausage stirred into non-veg portions.

**Produce**
- Onion (2), carrot (2), celery (2 stalks), garlic (1 head), baby spinach (small bag), green onions (1 bunch), lime (optional)
- Frozen peas (1 bag), frozen corn (1 bag), frozen mixed veg (1 bag, for Saturday)

**Pantry**
- Dried lentils (1 lb bag), canned diced tomatoes (1–2 cans), veggie/chicken bouillon or broth
- Pasta (2 boxes), microwave rice pouches (2–3), canned black beans (2 cans)
- Ramen or vermicelli noodles (1 pack), jarred tomato/marinara sauce (1 jar), salsa (1 jar), taco seasoning
- Soy sauce, sesame oil, cumin, bay leaf (if not already stocked)

**Dairy/Eggs**
- Eggs (1 dozen), butter, parmesan (block or grated), shredded cheese, sour cream (small), milk or cream (small), sliced bread + a loaf for grilled cheese

**Optional proteins** (skip entirely if not needed, or buy small quantities to stretch across meals)
- Firm tofu (1 block) — doubles as the default veg-friendly protein
- Smoked sausage or shrimp (small pack) — for Monday
- Ground beef or rotisserie chicken — for Tuesday
- Italian sausage — for Thursday

**Keep stocked (not a weekly buy, just check levels):** olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, soy sauce, sesame oil.

Here's a full Saturday–Thursday dinner plan built around your setup: 2 burners + microwave, quick vegetarian bases (so your partner never needs a separate meal), simple optional meat/seafood add-ins for you, nothing spicy, and ingredients that overlap across the week to keep costs down.

## Quick Overview

| Day | Meal | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Sat | Vegetable Fried Rice | ~40 min |
| Sun | One-Pot Minestrone with Cheese Tortellini | ~50 min |
| Mon | Garlic Butter Pasta with Peas & Parmesan | ~20 min |
| Tue | Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas + Corn-Tomato Salad | ~20 min |
| Wed | Mild Coconut Chickpea & Spinach Stew over Rice | ~25 min |
| Thu | Creamy Tomato Soup + Grilled Cheese | ~20 min |

---

## Saturday — Vegetable Fried Rice (~40 min)
**Ingredients:** rice (2 cups cooked), 2 eggs, 1 carrot (diced), ½ cup frozen peas, ½ cup corn, 2 garlic cloves, 2 scallions, soy sauce, oil, salt/pepper.
**Steps:**
1. Cook rice on burner 1 (~18 min) — start this first.
2. While it cooks, scramble eggs in a big skillet on burner 2, set aside.
3. Sauté garlic, carrot, peas, corn in the same skillet ~5 min.
4. Add rice + soy sauce, stir-fry 5 min, fold eggs and scallions back in.
**Meat add-in:** sear shrimp or diced cooked chicken separately, stir into your portion.

## Sunday — One-Pot Minestrone with Cheese Tortellini (~50 min)
**Ingredients:** onion, garlic, 2 carrots, 2 celery stalks, 1 can diced tomatoes, 4 cups veg broth, 1 can white beans, 1 zucchini, 1 pkg cheese tortellini, parmesan, Italian seasoning.
**Steps:**
1. Sauté onion/garlic/carrot/celery in a pot, 5 min.
2. Add broth, tomatoes, beans; simmer 20 min.
3. Add zucchini and tortellini, cook 8–10 min until tortellini floats.
4. Meanwhile, toast garlic bread in a skillet on burner 2.
**Meat add-in:** boil a handful of frozen meatballs on the side, drop into your bowl.

## Monday — Garlic Butter Pasta with Peas & Parmesan (~20 min)
**Ingredients:** short pasta, butter, garlic, frozen peas, parmesan.
**Steps:**
1. Boil pasta (burner 1); toss peas in during the last 2 minutes.
2. Melt butter + garlic in a pan (burner 2), toss in drained pasta/peas + parmesan + splash of pasta water.
**Meat add-in:** pan-sear sliced chicken sausage on burner 2 alongside, mix into your bowl.

## Tuesday — Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas + Corn-Tomato Salad (~20 min)
**Ingredients:** tortillas, shredded cheese, 1 can black beans (drained, lightly mashed), corn, cherry tomatoes, lime, sour cream/mild salsa.
**Steps:**
1. Mix corn (microwave-thawed), diced tomato, lime, salt for the salad.
2. Fill tortillas with beans + cheese, crisp in a skillet 3–4 min/side, in batches.
**Meat add-in:** add shredded rotisserie chicken into the filling for your portion.

## Wednesday — Mild Coconut Chickpea & Spinach Stew over Rice (~25 min)
**Ingredients:** rice, 1 can chickpeas, 1 can coconut milk, 1 can diced tomatoes, spinach, onion, garlic, mild curry powder (or turmeric + cumin, no chili).
**Steps:**
1. Cook rice on burner 1 (~18–20 min) — or use rice you batch-cooked extra of on Sunday to save time.
2. Sauté onion/garlic, spices 2 min; add tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas, simmer 10 min; stir in spinach until wilted.
**Meat add-in:** pan-sear shrimp separately, stir into your bowl.

## Thursday — Creamy Tomato Soup + Grilled Cheese (~20 min)
**Ingredients:** canned crushed tomatoes, veg broth, milk, butter, garlic, bread, cheddar slices.
**Steps:**
1. Sauté garlic, add tomatoes + broth + milk, simmer 10 min (burner 1).
2. Grill cheese sandwiches in a skillet on burner 2, batches of 3–4 min/side.
**Meat add-in:** crisp bacon bits, stir into soup or tuck into your sandwich.

---

## Shopping List (Sunday shop)

**Produce:** onion (2–3), garlic (1 head), carrots (3), celery (2–3 stalks), zucchini (1), baby spinach (1 bag), scallions (1 bunch), cherry tomatoes (1 pint), lime (1)

**Canned/Jarred:** diced tomatoes (2 cans), crushed tomatoes (1 can), black beans (1 can), white beans (1 can), chickpeas (1 can), coconut milk (1 can), corn (1 bag frozen or 1 can), frozen peas (1 bag), vegetable broth (1 carton)

**Grains/Bread:** rice (1 bag), short pasta (1 box), cheese tortellini (1 pkg), sandwich bread (1 loaf), flour tortillas (1 pack)

**Dairy/Eggs:** eggs (1 dozen), block cheddar (shred yourself, cheaper), parmesan, butter, milk, sour cream (optional)

**Pantry basics you likely have or should stock:** oil, soy sauce, mild curry powder (or turmeric + cumin), Italian seasoning, salt, pepper

**Optional (only if adding meat/seafood):** frozen shrimp, chicken sausage or rotisserie chicken, bacon, a small bag of frozen meatballs

---

## Tips
- **Cook extra rice on Sunday** — enough for Wednesday too — to shave stove time off a weeknight.
- Skipping meat entirely one or two nights (it's easy here, most meals are already vegetarian) is the cheapest option; add-ins are optional per person, not required for the base recipe.
- Buy block cheese instead of pre-shredded — noticeably cheaper and melts better.
- Kid can skip cilantro/salsa on Tuesday and get a plain cheese quesadilla if preferred — same base recipe works.
